exposure: Ultrasound-guided high-intensity focused ultrasound (USgHIFU) treatment of adenomyosis
cohort: A 39-year-old female, gravida 0 para 0, with a history of bilateral ovarian endometrioma post laparoscopic surgery, suspected deep infiltrative endometriosis (DIE), adenomyosis, and repeated implantation failure.
finding: Ultrasound-guided high-intensity focused ultrasound (USgHIFU) can be a potential treatment option in segmented in vitro fertilization for patients with repeated implantation failure and adenomyosis.
mod_finding: Two healthy newborns were delivered by Cesarean section due to antepartum hemorrhage with placenta previa and preeclampsia.
